title: Trajectory checkpoint and risk tease
summary: Monthly all-hands focused on trajectory review: topline metrics, a brief product demo tease, infrastructure risk posture, hiring plan adjustments, and an extended Q&A. Some audio glitches; informal tone. Action items captured at the end.
action_items: Priya: Finalize Q1 product roadmap doc and share with leadership by 2026-01-27
Jordan: Postmortem draft for Dec 18th infra blip due 2026-01-23
Samir: Confirm SOC2 evidence collection plan and send to compliance by 2026-01-30
Avery: Update hiring forecast and headcount delta for finance by 2026-01-25
next_steps: Leadership to review roadmap and come with 2 risks each to the Feb 3rd strategy session
Product marketing will get a short teaser deck for customer-facing comms (Priya)
Infra to run a 72-hour high-load soak in staging next week and report results
transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-01-20T10:00 PST
Duration: ~72 minutes
Attendees: Maya (CEO), Ethan (CTO), Priya (VP Product), Jordan (Infra), Samir (Security), Avery (Host) + company-wide

Summary (auto): Quick cadence check. High-level wins, two small incident reviews, roadmap highlights, hiring cadence tweak, security checklist. Q&A ran long.

[00:00] Avery: okay hi everyone. thanks for joining on time, we wanted to do a quick trajectory checkpoint, not a full deck — just highlights and then open q and a. we'll keep to an hour but we'll stretch if needed.
[00:35] Maya: yeah uh really proud of the team for hitting the throughput targets in November and December, stellar work. small correction — our net new revenue run rate is up, but conversion from free tier to paid is still the area to attack.
[01:05] Ethan: one note on infra — the December blip was, uh, an interaction between the autoscaler and a new GPU allocation policy, so thanks to Jordan's team for triaging. we have a mitigation in place but we'll cover the postmortem.
[01:40] Priya: product side we'll do a quick peek at the Dedicated rollout plan and a tiny demo of the private deployment onboarding flow. note that the demo is intentionally short; it's a teaser more than a how-to.
[02:05] Jordan: ops recap — staging soak last week had a 3% higher p99 under long sequences, likely due to KV cache churn. we have a patch queued that should reduce re-evictions.
[02:40] Samir: on security, the SOC2 readiness scan is 70% complete, remaining evidences are access logs and a couple of config audits. I'll share the evidence map after this call.
[03:10] Avery: ok quick data points: usage growth month-over-month 18%, embeddings consumption up 46% in target accounts, cost per token improved by caching & batching experiments, still seeing variance on long-context workloads.
[03:45] Audience comment (Slack): hey when's the next customer benchmark?
[03:55] Maya: good Q. we'll run a public benchmark in March but sales & SEs can request private runs earlier — we'll prioritize enterprise POCs.
[04:20] Priya: demo time. sharing screen. this is the Private onboarding wizard — team note, we shortened the SSO step after the pilot feedback, less friction. audio: slight echo here, sorry.
[05:00] [demo narration omitted; audience could see the flow] Priya: steps are: register deployment, pick model profile, choose quantization/latency profile, warmup policy, deploy. it ties into the rollout engine for canaries.
[05:45] Ethan: a technical aside — the runtime now selects kernels for long-context and short bursts differently; that cut p99 on bursty workloads by ~20% during benching. results vary by model family.
[06:15] Jordan: on cost controls — we shipped a per-customer batching cap that limits runaway batch sizes; this saves a lot on spike events.
[06:50] Maya: on go-to-market, we tightened our ICP so enterprise platform teams who care about predictable inference economics are top priority. PLG still core for developer adoption.
[07:20] Avery: hiring update — we've slowed hiring for non-critical ICs for this quarter, but we're accelerating for infra SREs and two senior SE roles. headcount delta will be shared after finance sync.
[07:45] Samir: compliance: one outstanding item is key management mapping for private deployments; customers want KMS/HSM options. we're onboarding a KMS partner for proofs.
[08:10] Audience question (via Q): what about on-prem vs VPC demand?
[08:25] Priya: ramping both; private demand is outpacing on-prem, but regulated customers still need on-prem. we need a clearer pricing signal.
[08:50] Maya: finance is working on packaging — goal is avoid complexity for buyers while preserving margin.
[09:10] [10:00 audio glitch, gap ~6s]
[09:20] Ethan: ops item — we plan to add a secondary fallback model family for critical traffic so we can degrade gracefully when high-capacity models are constrained; we want this by late Feb.
[09:50] Jordan: also improving multi-region routing to avoid cascading fallbacks when a regional cluster is unhealthy.
[10:20] Avery: ok let's go to the incident summary. Jordan, you want to walk through the Dec 18th blip?
[10:35] Jordan: yes. root cause: autoscaler policy didn't account for partial GPU reclaim during slot compaction, which caused a transient scheduling failure for a critical host. impact: ~12 minutes of elevated latency for a subset of customers. actions taken: revert policy, create unit tests for slot compaction, and tighten monitoring for GPU slot fragmentation. next: postmortem doc will be live by Friday.
[11:15] Audience: thanks — will that affect dedicated SLA?
[11:25] Ethan: no SLA change; it was an edge-case under particular reclaim behavior. still, we're treating as priority.
[11:40] Maya: ok staffing — Jordan's team will get two more hires approved this sprint to improve capacity tooling.
[12:05] Priya: product risk: we have a potential regression risk with the fast-batching toggle when combined with prefix caching; we flagged a guardrail to disable toggle during heavy KV churn workloads.
[12:40] Samir: security note — we need to accelerate audit logging retention and make log exports tamper-evident; customers asked for longer retention windows. we'll propose a plan by next week.
[13:10] Avery: financials snapshot — burn rate control remains a focus, we've identified ~3.8% potential savings from infra tweaks and vendor renegotiation; aim to present detailed plan to board.
[13:40] Maya: inbound partner interest is good; we got two sizable channel partnership inquiries. we'll prioritize one for APAC market expansion.
[14:05] Audience Q&A starts:
[14:10] Staff (Speaker 1): question — what's the timeline for private beta expansion?
[14:25] Priya: private beta will expand to additional 10 customers by Feb 12th, targeting LatAm and UK customers for regional testing.
[14:50] Staff (Speaker 2): will there be changes to free tier limits?
[14:58] Avery: not immediate, product will propose an experiment and we'll announce with clear guardrails.
[15:20] Staff (Speaker 3): any update on docs and SDKs?
[15:30] Ethan: docs team shipping an SDK patch for streaming and tool-calling next week. please file issues in the docs board.
[15:55] Audience (quiet murmurs)
[16:10] Maya: quick shoutout to infra and SEs for the year-end push — retention of top performers is high. keep building.
[16:35] Priya: marketing will publish two customer-facing case studies next month; they'll be short and focused on latency wins.
[16:55] Jordan: ops will do the 72h soak starting Monday at 03:00 UTC, will post results to #infra-results.
[17:20] Samir: compliance — runbook updates incoming, we'll share the checklist for SOC2 readiness; ask security for clarifications if you need evidence mapping.
[17:45] Avery: closing remarks — this was a status checkpoint, not a panic. focus on three things: reliability, margin, and predictable growth. next all-hands will touch deeper on the roadmap post-leadership retreats.
[18:10] Maya: quick open mic — any burning items?
[18:25] Speaker 4: is there a hiring freeze for product ICs?
[18:33] Avery: not a freeze per se, just prioritization; we will keep hiring key roles.
[18:55] Speaker 5: can we get a TL;DR email?
[19:05] Avery: yes, will send a one-pager and action item list after the call.
[19:25] [Q&A continues; raised hands, short answers]
[28:00] [end of recorded portion — remaining discussion was side-channel and small-team follow ups not captured fully]

Notes: Transcript contains some mis-attributions and a short audio dropout at ~09:10. Demo screens referenced but not fully transcribed.

Recap and explicit next steps:
- Priya: roadmap doc by 2026-01-27
- Jordan: postmortem draft by 2026-01-23
- Samir: SOC2 evidence plan by 2026-01-30
- Avery: headcount delta to finance by 2026-01-25

Thank you everyone for joining.
